Record Class PoseObservation

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
frc.spectrumLib.localization.PoseObservation
Record Components:
source - source name, e.g. "LL-Back/MT1", "Orin-Left", "Quest"
kind - what produced it, which decides which gates and std-dev model apply
timestampSeconds - capture time, in the same time base as Timer.getTimestamp()
pose - robot pose on the field (3-D, so tilt and height gates can see a bad solve)
tagCount - AprilTags in the solve, or -1 for a source with no tags
avgTagDistanceMeters - mean camera-to-tag distance, or NaN
targetSizePercent - Limelight target area as a percentage of the image, or NaN
maxAmbiguity - largest single-tag ambiguity in the solve (0..1), or NaN
tracking - VIO tracking flag; true for sources that have no such notion
stdDevScale - multiplier the source's trust model applies to its std-devs, e.g. the Orin's image-edge and per-camera factors; 1 for sources without one
public record PoseObservation(String source, PoseObservation.Kind kind, double timestampSeconds, Pose3d pose, int tagCount, double avgTagDistanceMeters, double targetSizePercent, double maxAmbiguity, boolean tracking, double stdDevScale) extends Record
One robot-pose measurement from one source, before any gating.

This is the 2026 Vision.VisionFieldPoseEstimate (pose + timestamp + covariance) promoted out of Vision, with the fields every gate in the 2026 code actually read made explicit, a source so the fused log can say where each measurement came from, and tagCount optional so a VIO source like QuestNav fits the same shape.

Every field here is derived from a logged AdvantageKit input, so a replayed log rebuilds the exact same observations and a gate threshold can be changed and re-run against a real match.
